records.jp: どうしたんですか、森崎さん。<CR>具合でも悪いんですか？
records.en_original: What's wrong, Alesia? Are you not feeling well?
records.en: What's wrong, Alesia? Are you not feeling well?

records.jp: 小瓶に灰を集めてるだけ。<CR>色んな種類の、綺麗な灰を集めるのが好きだから
records.en_original: I'm just collecting Ash in these little bottles. I like collecting different types of beautiful ashes.
records.en: I'm just collecting Ash in these little bottles. I like collecting different types of beautiful ashes.

records.jp: あ、危ないですよ、そんなことしたら！！<CR>ただでさえ近づかない方がいいものなのに
records.en_original: W-wait, that's dangerous! It's not something you should be messing with to begin with!
records.en: W-wait, that's dangerous! It's not something you should be messing with to begin with!

records.jp: 灰地域と居住地域。<CR>生きていることと死んでいること
records.en_original: The Ashen Zone and the residential area represent an interesting dichotomy. Just like life and death.
records.en: The Ashen Zone and the residential area represent an interesting dichotomy. Just like life and death.

records.jp: それは、始まりでも、終わりでもない。<CR>ただ単に、その存在の状態が変わっただけ
records.en_original: It's not a beginning or an end. It's just that the state of being changes.
records.en: It's not a beginning or an end. It's just that the state of being changes.

records.jp: そう考えれば、灰地域の拡大も、死も、<CR>怖がる必要はないでしょう？
records.en_original: If you think of it that way, there's no reason to be afraid of the Ash spreading—or of death, right?
records.en: If you think of it that way, there's no reason to be afraid of the Ash spreading—or of death, right?

records.jp: そんなの無理ですよ！<CR>誰だって死ぬのは怖いです
records.en_original: That's impossible! Everyone's scared of dying.
records.en: That's impossible! Everyone's scared of dying.

records.jp: 私は怖くないし、いつ死んでも構わないと思ってる。<CR>死は必然として訪れるものだから
records.en_original: I'm not scared. I don't care if I die at any time. Death is something that comes for all of us eventually.
records.en: I'm not scared. I don't care if I die at any time. Death is something that comes for all of us eventually.

records.jp: この身体は、必ず壊れるように設計されている。<CR>それが今日か、数十年後かの違いでしかない
records.en_original: Our bodies are built to break down, eventually. The only difference is whether it happens today or decades from now.
records.en: Our bodies are built to break down, eventually. The only difference is whether it happens today or decades from now.

records.jp: ……そんな悲しいこと、言わないでください
records.en_original: Please don't talk about such sad things.
records.en: Please don't talk about such sad things.

records.jp: あっ、そうだ！
records.en_original: Oh, right!
records.en: Oh, right!

records.jp: あのっ！　森崎さん、<CR>これ、持っててほしくて。受け取ってください！
records.en_original: Um, Alesia, I wanted you to have this. Please take it!
records.en: Um, Alesia, I wanted you to have this. Please take it!

records.jp: ……小瓶のキーホルダー？<CR>この中に入ってるのって……
records.en_original: A keychain with a little bottle? What's inside it?
records.en: A keychain with a little bottle? What's inside it?

records.jp: 星の砂です。わたしこれが大好きで、<CR>わたしも同じのを持ってるんですけど
records.en_original: It's star sand. I really love this stuff. I actually have one just like it.
records.en: It's star sand. I really love this stuff. I actually have one just like it.

records.jp: 少しでも森崎さんと近づけたらと思って、<CR>お揃いなんです。一緒に頑張っていけたらって
records.en_original: I wanted to get a little closer to you, Alesia, so I thought it would be nice if we could match each other. I hope we can do our best together.
records.en: I wanted to get a little closer to you, Alesia, so I thought it would be nice if we could match each other. I hope we can do our best together.

records.jp: だから、いつ死んでも構わないなんて言わないで――
records.en_original: So please, don't say you don't care if you die.
records.en: So please, don't say you don't care if you die.

records.jp: ……やめて
records.en_original: ...Stop.
records.en: ...Stop.

records.jp: あ、あの、森崎さん……？
records.en_original: Um, Alesia?
records.en: Um, Alesia?

records.jp: 私はただ、この均衡を失いたくないだけなの
records.en_original: I just...don't want to lose this balance I have.
records.en: I just...don't want to lose this balance I have.

records.jp: （うそ……星の砂……捨てられた………）
records.en_original: (No way... She threw the star sand away.)
records.en: (No way... She threw the star sand away.)

records.jp: そ、そんな……
records.en_original: N-no...
records.en: N-no...

records.jp: このビンは灰を入れるのに使わせてもらうわ
records.en_original: I'll use this bottle to hold Ash.
records.en: I'll use this bottle to hold Ash.

records.jp: ……これでわかったでしょ？<CR>私といても、貴方は幸せにはならない
records.en_original: Do you get it now? If you stay with me, you'll never be happy.
records.en: Do you get it now? If you stay with me, you'll never be happy.

records.jp: 私に関わろうとしないで。<CR>私は……死神だから
records.en_original: Don't get involved with me. I... I'm the grim reaper, you see.
records.en: Don't get involved with me. I... I'm the grim reaper, you see.

records.jp: しに、がみ……？
records.en_original: The grim reaper?
records.en: The grim reaper?

records.jp: …………貴方を見ていると、<CR>思い出すの。亜美のことを
records.en_original: ...When I look at you, I remember Ami.
records.en: ...When I look at you, I remember Ami.

records.jp: もう一度言う。これ以上、私に関わらないで
records.en_original: I'll say it again. Don't get any more involved with me.
records.en: I'll say it again. Don't get any more involved with me.

records.jp: 詩帆、アレシア、無事か！？
records.en_original: Shiho! Alesia! Are you okay?!
records.en: Shiho! Alesia! Are you okay?!

records.jp: ええ。どうしたの、そんなに慌てて？
records.en_original: Yeah. What's wrong? Why are you so flustered?
records.en: Yeah. What's wrong? Why are you so flustered?

records.jp: リーダーが、異灰が身体を通り過ぎていくような<CR>変な感覚があったらしいんだけど
records.en_original: Leader said he felt something strange, like a Testa passed right through his body.
records.en: Leader said he felt something strange, like a Testa passed right through his body.

records.jp: 私の力でエーテルの流れを追ったら、こっちに……
records.en_original: I traced the flow of Ether with my powers and it led here.
records.en: I traced the flow of Ether with my powers and it led here.

records.jp: 身体を通り過ぎていく感覚……？
records.en_original: A sensation of something passing through your body?
records.en: A sensation of something passing through your body?

records.jp: ん？　おい、詩帆。<CR>ボーッとしているようだが平気なのか？
records.en_original: Hm? Hey, Shiho. You seem kinda spaced out. Are you all right?
records.en: Hm? Hey, Shiho. You seem kinda spaced out. Are you all right?

records.jp: ……はい
records.en_original: Yes...
records.en: Yes...

records.jp: 美岐、今の言葉……、<CR>私、前にも同じ言葉を聞いてる
records.en_original: Meiqi, I swear I've heard those exact words before.
records.en: Meiqi, I swear I've heard those exact words before.

records.jp: なに？　<CR>異灰が身体を通り過ぎていく感覚――というやつか？
records.en_original: What? You mean the sensation of a Testa passing through your body?
records.en: What? You mean the sensation of a Testa passing through your body?

records.jp: そう。亜美が同じことを言っていた
records.en_original: Yeah. Ami said the exact same thing.
records.en: Yeah. Ami said the exact same thing.

records.jp: そして、その言葉は、<CR>私が亜美を殺すことになった原因でもある
records.en_original: And those words...they're the reason I ended up killing Ami.
records.en: And those words...they're the reason I ended up killing Ami.

records.jp: きゃあああああああああっっ！！！！
records.en_original: Eeeek!
records.en: Eeeek!

records.jp: 詩帆！？　どうした、詩帆！！
records.en_original: Shiho?! What's wrong, Shiho?!
records.en: Shiho?! What's wrong, Shiho?!

records.jp: な、何かがっ……わたしの中を……まさぐってる………
records.en_original: S-something's...messing around...inside me...
records.en: S-something's...messing around...inside me...

records.jp: 詩帆の中を？<CR>まさか！！
records.en_original: Inside you? No way!
records.en: Inside you? No way!

records.jp: 大変、全身に異灰のエーテルを纏ってる！<CR>けど、これは……
records.en_original: This is bad—her whole body's wrapped in the Testa's Ether! But this feels...
records.en: This is bad—her whole body's wrapped in the Testa's Ether! But this feels...

records.jp: 微妙にエーテルがブレてる……つまり、<CR>詩帆の中にもう１つ、別の何かが潜んでる可能性がある
records.en_original: The Ether's kinda unstable...which means, there might be something else hidden inside Shiho.
records.en: The Ether's kinda unstable...which means, there might be something else hidden inside Shiho.

records.jp: くっ、なんてことだ。<CR>リーダー、何かいい方法はないか！？
records.en_original: Ugh, this is bad. Leader, do you have any ideas?!
records.en: Ugh, this is bad. Leader, do you have any ideas?!

records.jp: なるほど。エーテルフェログラムで<CR>詩帆の中を確認する、か……それしか方法はなさそうだ
records.en_original: I see. Checking inside Shiho with Ether Pherogram... That might be our only option.
records.en: I see. Checking inside Shiho with Ether Pherogram... That might be our only option.

records.jp: ということは、その間無防備になるリーダーを<CR>守らないといけないってことか
records.en_original: So that means we've gotta protect Leader in the meantime—he'll be totally defenseless.
records.en: So that means we've gotta protect Leader in the meantime—he'll be totally defenseless.

records.jp: ……よくわからないけど、<CR>時間を稼げというならそうする
records.en_original: I'm not exactly sure what's going on, but if you need time, I'll buy you some.
records.en: I'm not exactly sure what's going on, but if you need time, I'll buy you some.
